name: Shouboushi-tachi no Ren'ai Jijou
original_name: 消防士たちの恋愛事情
source:
You're a rookie firefighter, the only girl in an otherwise fully male station. You expected your boss and colleagues to be stern but, they're surprisingly warm towards you?!

You're marked from a certain arson incident in your past of which you're trying to find the reason. And your colleagues seem to be hiding secrets as well... Will you choose one of this men to help you in your quest and maybe something more?
translation:
你是一名新手消防员，是一个完全由男性组成的消防站中唯一的女孩。你以为你的老板和同事会很严厉，但他们对你却出奇的热情？！

你因过去的某起纵火事件而受到标记，你正试图找出原因。而你的同事似乎也隐藏着秘密……你会选择其中一个人来帮助你完成任务，甚至做更多的事情吗？
